# oneprovider_vm_tag (Resource)

Manages a tag in a VM project. Destroying the tag also removes its assignments from all services. To detach a tag from just one VM, edit that VM's tags instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    oneprovider = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/MadJlzz/oneprovider"
    }
  }
}

provider "oneprovider" {}

data "oneprovider_vm_project" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

resource "oneprovider_vm_tag" "managed" {
  project     = data.oneprovider_vm_project.production.id
  label       = "terraform managed"
  description = "VMs managed by Terraform"
}

# To assign the tag in a oneprovider_vm_instance resource:
# tags = [oneprovider_vm_tag.managed.id]
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label of the tag.
- `project` (String) UUID of the project that owns the tag. Changing it replaces the tag.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the tag. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag ID to use in the tags attribute of a VM instance.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a tag by its project UUID and tag ID.
terraform import oneprovider_vm_tag.managed '<project_uuid>/<tag_id>'
```
